title: RFID Defect Analytics Dashboard
description: End-to-end analytics dashboard integrating manufacturing defect data from CSV and REST API sources to monitor production quality in real time.
problem: Quality teams lacked a unified, drill-down view of defect trends across products, production lines, and severity levels — decisions relied on manual spreadsheet checks.
insights: Applied Linear Regression, Z-score anomaly detection, and Chi-square tests to flag abnormal months and validate defect-location/severity relationships
Surfaced high-risk production lines and dominant defect categories to speed up quality-control decisions

title: IQVIA Pharmaceutical Market Analysis
description: Interactive Power BI dashboard analyzing the pharmaceutical market from 62,098 therapeutic products across 2019–2022.
problem: Raw therapeutic-product exports were too granular and inconsistent by sales channel/year to compare market trends at a glance.
insights: ETL via Power Query transformed 62,098 rows into a ~500,000-row analysis model
Retail channel accounts for ~60% of sales with continuous growth 2019–2022; Hospital channel recovered after a 2021 decline

title: DJIA Stock Market Analysis
description: Fact-dimension PostgreSQL data model analyzing DJIA stock prices and company fundamentals from 2023–2026 to compare sector performance.
problem: Yahoo Finance exports needed a proper relational structure before they could support repeatable sector-level comparisons and screening.
insights: Designed fact_stock_price / dim_company model and loaded data via SQLAlchemy
Technology sector leads in market cap; Financial Services records the highest average closing price; flagged near-52-week-low stocks as value watch-list candidates

title: McDonald's Menu Nutrition Analysis
description: Interactive Power BI dashboard analyzing nutritional data across all McDonald's menu categories.
problem: Menu nutrition data had no easy way to compare healthiness across categories or recommend lower-calorie choices per meal type.
insights: Built DAX measures for per-category averages and healthiness scores
Dashboard recommends lower-calorie options per meal type
